mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.spot_name, sp.photo_url, r.average_rating, sc.name AS sub_category_name, c.name AS category_name, s.keywords FROM spots s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM spot_photos WHERE spot_id = s.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) sp ON true LEFT JOIN ( SELECT spot_id, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY spot_id ) r ON r.spot_id = s.id INNER JOIN sub_categories sc ON sc.id = s.sub_category_id INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = sc.category_id ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id, spot_name, sub_category_id, website_url, gmap_url, address, business_hours, closed_days, estimated_budget, keywords, details, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at FROM spots
deleted_at IS NULL
AND ( spot_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT count(*) FROM spots
deleted_at IS NULL
AND ( spot_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR keywords LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

SELECT s.id, s.spot_name, sp.photo_url, r.average_rating, sc.name AS sub_category_name, c.name AS category_name, s.keywords FROM spots s LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM spot_photos WHERE spot_id = s.id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1 ) sp ON true JOIN ( SELECT spot_id, AVG(rating) AS average_rating FROM reviews GROUP BY spot_id ) r ON r.spot_id = s.id JOIN sub_categories sc ON sc.id = s.sub_category_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = sc.category_id ORDER BY average_rating DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 3

SELECT s.id,s.spot_name,c.name AS category_name,,sc.name AS sub_category_name,,s.sub_category_id, s.website_url, s.gmap_url, s.address, s.business_hours, s.closed_days, s.estimated_budget, s.keywords, s.details, s.deleted_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at FROM spots s JOIN sub_categories sc ON sc.id = s.sub_category_id JOIN categories c ON c.id = sc.category_id WHERE c.name = #{name} ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC
